title: Aberrations
description: Adds a powerful item, the Tesseract. You can use it to Rewire items into other items, and infuse items with other items to get incredibly powerful gear.
body:
![aberrations logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/91a096f04323c496067cd32e6a867856a6f68b42.png)

Adds several items, with the main one being the Tesseract. it is used for creating most of the items in the mod, or for Rewiring existing items, such as rewiring Sand to a Blast Furnace.

Here's the equation for the rewiring calculation: **C+O+I*E**
Where C = Chaos (The slider), O = Order (The slider), I = the item's value (which is arbitrarily assigned in a proccess even I don't fully understand) and E = Essence which is .5 for default, .6 for purified and .2 for Orderly.

Also made using mcreator. I seriously don't want to learn Java LMAO

Most of the vanilla textures were used from the [Minecraft Wiki](https://minecraft.wiki/), and I used [pixilart](https://www.pixilart.com/draw#) for quite a few of the textures.

Guide: [CLICKHERE](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1fUQ7_XPFMV8wZMevgDrDtboTnap3dlXTrZZx-Uh5cJg/edit?usp=sharing)
